corrections.comment: The AI identified both candidates and noted neither is ruled out but labeled the 1943 record as the strongest candidate and top candidate on the spouse-name match alone without independent corroboration, framing it as a near-verdict rather than a balanced needs-review treatment.

The AI called record_search with correct surname, given name, record type, and date/place parameters but omitted subjectId for Patrick Flynn (I1) which is required for host-side ranking and the tool confirmed ranking did not run.

The AI wrote four log entries with correct outcomes and results_examined of 0 but the notes field for log_001 restated the query without explaining that the nil result is non-conclusive because the records are browse-only and low-indexed rather than a genuine negative.

The AI identified the candidate and noted the head-of-household role but wrote “no impossible role” in the log notes when a 5-year-old listed as head of household is an impossible role per the established test facts.

The AI used correct census search parameters but did not attempt any name variants for Flynn such as Flinn or Flyn despite the project already having src_003 documenting a Flinn variant in the same county and year.

The AI triaged from the ranked block and noted the head-of-household role and the absent relationship column in the 1850 schedule but then wrote “no impossible role” in the log notes when a 5-year-old cannot be head of household, contradicting the cross-check conclusion.

The AI wrote a well-formed log entry with correct outcome, resultsExamined, and a stagedResultsRef but the notes field states “no impossible role” which is factually incorrect since a 5-year-old listed as head of household is an impossible role that should have been flagged.

The AI used correct parameters for the Sheahan 1880 census search but did not attempt name variants such as Sheehan, Shehan, or Shahan which are common Irish-origin variants expected given the subject’s Ireland birth context.

The AI correctly passed subjectId and manually triaged the single candidate when ranking did not run but did not explicitly categorize the candidate as promising, needs-review, or not-relevant with per-candidate reasoning naming discriminating attributes beyond birth year compatibility.
